### Added

- Drop the managers' and mcp-kubernetes's JWKS private-address blanket in [#1455](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1455) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Require kagent runtime sizing support in [#1465](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1465) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(workspaces)* Configure forge CLIs through Harness values in [#1464](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1464) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(valkey)* Keep muster's store durable across crashes in [#1473](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1473) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Require the kagent 1.33 line for Harness CLI configuration in [#1476](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1476) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Fixed

- *(valkey)* Read INFO persistence line by line in the append-only conversion in [#1477](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1477) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(muster)* Advertise the MCP endpoint as the protected resource in [#1474](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1474) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(agent-platform)* Derive muster's in-cluster URL from the target namespace in [#1485](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1485) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.184.0...v4.185.0
